chosen_titles.rationale: Title 24 (GOVERNMENT - STATE) houses C.R.S. Title 24 Art. 6 Pt. 3 §§ 24-6-301 to 24-6-309, the lobbyist-registration and expenditure-reporting regime, plus the Independent Ethics Commission provisions cross-referenced from the lobbying chapter.

notes: Justia returned a 404 'Page not found' for https://law.justia.com/codes/colorado/2025/; substituted vintage 2024 per handoff Step 1 triage. CO lobbying-disclosure regime lives entirely within Title 24: legislative-branch lobbying registration at Art. 6 Pt. 3 (§§ 24-6-301 to 24-6-309) and the Independent Ethics Commission at Art. 18.5. Title 1 (ELECTIONS) is campaign finance, intentionally excluded. Title 2 (LEGISLATIVE) covers legislative procedure, not lobbying disclosure.
